facts.fact: INSD's Annuaire statistique national 2024, published December 2025 (figures cover up to 2024), compiles data from sectoral ministries' yearbooks, dashboards and activity reports; its table list includes civil-registration indicators (table 2.1.26) and its tables cite the territorial administration ministry's statistics directorate (DGESS/MATDC); the captured text is cut before the later chapters.
